changes: Fixed a real gap in the previous ambience fix. That fix only ever stopped the lobby noise once, at the exact moment a Live Blackjack table opens — but the app's own ambience-reconciling logic also runs independently whenever the screen locks and unlocks, or the app is switched away from and back to, and since the table view still isn't recognized as "a game" by that check, any one of those could quietly restart the ambience mid-session without ever actually leaving the table. Now re-checked on every 3-second poll tick too, not just once at entry, so it can't stay wrong for more than a few seconds no matter what tries to restart it.
